Temperature: after ovulation, progesterone raises your resting temperature by about 0.2–0.5 °C until your next period. When 3 readings in a row are higher than the 6 before them, and the third is at least 0.2 °C above that level (the coverline), ovulation is confirmed. It most likely happened the day before the first high reading. The rise comes after ovulation: it confirms ovulation but cannot announce it. Ondea uses it to learn your ovulation day for the next cycles.

Cervical mucus: the first sign of mucus opens the fertile window. The peak day (P) is the last day of the best-quality mucus, and ovulation usually happens within a day of it. Following the symptothermal double check, the fertile phase only ends when both signs agree: the temperature rise is confirmed and 3 days have passed since the peak.

Before any sign appears, the fertile window is predicted from your past confirmed ovulations, your usual ovulation day, or your cycle length. It covers the 5 days before ovulation, ovulation day and the day after. It opens 5 days before your earliest recent ovulation, because the fertile window changes from cycle to cycle. Sperm can survive up to 5 days, and the egg about 1 day.

Ondea has no internet permission. Your data is encrypted on this phone with a key protected by the Android Keystore, and it is excluded from Android cloud backups.
Backups are encrypted with a password you choose. Save them wherever you like from the file picker: your phone, an SD card, or a cloud app that appears there (such as Proton Drive or Nextcloud).
Choose a strong password. Without it, nobody can restore the backup, not even you.
Replace all data on this phone with the content of this backup?
Not encrypted. Useful to share with a doctor.
Permanently delete everything on this phone
All your entries and settings will be permanently deleted from this phone. Backups you saved elsewhere are not affected.
Ondea is free and open-source software (GPL-3.0). No account, no ads, no tracking, no internet.

Methods: temperature shift (3-over-6 rule) and cervical mucus double check as used by the symptothermal method (Sensiplan; Frank-Herrmann et al., Human Reproduction 2007). Conception chance by day: Wilcox et al., NEJM 1995.
Ondea is meant to help you understand your cycle and find your most fertile days. It is not a medical device and must not be used as contraception. Consult a health professional for medical advice.
